correctness.rationale: Every one-type is an ideal/filter pair; a first-missing-lower partition yields I_n(u), and a first-selected-upper partition yields the mixed term. The disjoint sum implies T_n(1,1)=(2n+1)2^n. Uniform first-missing indices yield one-sided uniform-segment limits, and mixed first-selected indices have weights 2^n-2^{n-j}; binomial concentration and a coupling yield W1=O(n^-1/2). Exact mixture moments give covariance -23/192, variance 11/64, correlation -23/33. The packaged verify.py independently tests actual enlarged-poset transitivity for n=1..5 coefficient by coefficient; its finite tests are not the proof.
